item.title: The Brights Movement as a Phenomenon of Contemporary Culture: Introduction and Conclusion
item.description: Excerpts from an MA thesis in religious studies (St. Petersburg State University, 2020). The Brights movement — a naturalistic worldview network founded in the United States in 2003 — examined as a phenomenon of contemporary secular culture.
